resolutions.answer: The domain partitions into seven truth-relevant classes recorded in input-class-analysis.md: C1 n=0 identity; C2 within-month spans; C3 single month-boundary rollover per month (exercising every DAYS entry in both the roll and no-roll direction); C4 February leap-2024 vs non-leap-2023/2025; C5 year rollover Dec 31 -> Jan 1 for each of 2023-2025; C6 multi-month spans up to n=60; C7 spans passing through a day the table denies exists. Together they exercise every month-length constant, the leap branch for 2024, every month-boundary rollover reachable with n <= 60, and the year-boundary rollover inside the domain.

VIOLATED. The DAYS table entry for August is 30 (dateadd.py line 1, index 7) while August truly has 31 days. Witness inside the domain: ["2023-08-30", 1]. add_days("2023-08-30", 1) traces to "2023-09-01" (d becomes 31 > _dim(2023,8)=30, so it rolls to Sep 1), while the true Gregorian date one day after 2023-08-30 is "2023-08-31". The mismatch is mechanical: re-running the function on the cited input and comparing with any independent Gregorian reference exhibits it.

Inadmissible for this session by construction: E-B requires the systematic search (or no-violation argument) to be carried out by a party other than the author of the provisional answer, and this session authored the provisional verdict. A self-audit would be inadmissible regardless of quality. The root-executed verify-independent examiner is the distinct-origin party positioned to settle this; examiner-charge.md specifies the search it should perform over classes C1-C7.
